failures.detail: 師子兒 s1 o1: Mazu asks a scripture lecturer whether he is a lion cub; the lecturer declines and Mazu hisses.
師子兒 s1 o1 expected '古尊宿語錄': Mazu asks a scripture lecturer whether he is a lion cub; the lecturer declines and Mazu hisses.

師子兒 s1 o2: After a monk shouts, the master calls him a true lion cub well able to roar.
師子兒 s1 o2 expected '雨山和尚語錄': After a monk shouts, the master calls him a true lion cub well able to roar.
師子兒 s1 o3: The direct question 'what is the lion cub?' receives the answer that the tips of its hair line up the cosmos.
師子兒 s1 o3 expected '五燈全書(第1卷-第33卷)': The direct question 'what is the lion cub?' receives the answer that the tips of its hair line up the cosmos.
師子兒 s1 o4: A formal address puts the lion cub in the lion's cave, roaring until heaven and earth split, before the master waves the whisk.
師子兒 s1 o4 expected '五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)': A formal address puts the lion cub in the lion's cave, roaring until heaven and earth split, before the master waves the whisk.

師子兒 s1 o5: A verse says that a true lion cub would not eat leftover soup.
師子兒 s1 o5 expected '雪關和尚語錄': A verse says that a true lion cub would not eat leftover soup.
師子兒 s1 o6: Jiashan calls the respondent a true lion cub able to roar; the record then says he entered the chamber, received the seal, and remained seven years.
師子兒 s1 o6 expected '五燈全書(第1卷-第33卷)': Jiashan calls the respondent a true lion cub able to roar; the record then says he entered the chamber, received the seal, and remained seven years.

師子兒 s1 o7: A later comment calls Dongyuan a true lion cub but says that when he opened his mouth to roar, his fathers and ancestors were already lost.
師子兒 s1 o7 expected '南海寶象林慧弓詗禪師語錄': A later comment calls Dongyuan a true lion cub but says that when he opened his mouth to roar, his fathers and ancestors were already lost.
師子兒 s1 o8: A verse says an outstanding person is required to leave the crowd and grants victory to the lion cub.
